parsed.rationale: All three `ContentView` records are `type-alias-object` with empty `fields_or_signature`, and the structural evidence section reports null Jaccard, null shared_field_count, and null shared_ancestor — there is no structural overlap whatsoever. The name collision is a well-known SwiftUI convention artifact: every target (`WXUI`, `MusicShareKit`, `app:WXYC TV`) independently defines a `ContentView` as its local entry-point view. The first member additionally resides under `Shared/WXUI/Examples/WXUISampleApp/`, a path that signals sample-app scope regardless of the pipeline flag. Merging or extracting these would couple unrelated domain entry points across packages for no shared-logic benefit.
